posts.body:
Hi! I'm Sharkie/Marte/Marcos/Kyo, whatever name you want to call me it's okay.
I've had the goal of making at least one game in RPG Maker, and I'm here to, first, get rid of my fear of talking to people, and second, get some help if needed for my game!
I have always loved RPGMaker VX Ace, and a while ago I finally got it for free on Steam! So I'm super motivated to work on anything. :3
I also draw and I like making characters, but I struggle with developing ideas. My first language is spanish, so I may understand english wrong or phrase things awkwardly. Uh anyways that's all from me
I suck at intros help KAKWDKAWK
